identitySignals: A Smile America Partners compliance policy lists 'CA: Elliot Paul Schlang, DDS, Professional Corporation dba Big Smiles' as a Big Smiles entity, matching the agenda's 'Elliot Paul Schlang DDS, PC dba Big Smiles Dental Program'
Big Smiles runs in-school dental care for students, matching OUSD's 'Student health, support & family services' category and the Health Services Department
Big Smiles' operator ReachOut Healthcare America / Smile America Partners is headquartered in Phoenix, AZ (Wikipedia), matching the agenda's location
Weak point: no registry record (CA Secretary of State) for the professional corporation was confirmed, and the brand website does not name the corporation
research.notes: The link between the agenda's PC and the Big Smiles brand rests on one third-party compliance PDF (smileamericapartners.com CC_113 Vendor Management and Oversight Policy, 2024) that lists 'CA: Elliot Paul Schlang, DDS, Professional Corporation dba Big Smiles'. Brand phone lines (888.833.8441 for schools) belong to the program, not clearly to this specific PC, so omitted. No CA SOS entity number verified.

profile.summary: Big Smiles is a school-based dental program. It brings dental care to students at their schools, including exams, cleanings, fluoride, sealants, X-rays and fillings, using portable equipment and local licensed dentists and hygienists. The California entity is a dental professional corporation that does business as Big Smiles.
